methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches AI training program for workplace professionals - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's workplace AI training program signals potential for distributed capability-building in non-metro regions, testing whether peer-to-peer professional development can bridge the geographic AI literacy gap beyond traditional tech hubs.

signals.title: Virginia budget clears way for $100B Berry Hill data center campus
signals.signal_reading: A $100B data center campus in Berry Hill represents infrastructure concentration without guaranteed local capability development—physical AI infrastructure presence doesn't automatically translate to distributed workforce skills or deep community adoption.

signals.title: Virginia county asks all employees, including schools, to conserve power due to AI-driven electricity price hikes — state's 400-plus data centers steadily increasing demand, grid expansion, and pricing - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: NoVA's power conservation mandate due to data center electricity demand reveals how AI infrastructure concentration creates resource strain for schools and public services, potentially limiting rather than enabling broad-based AI capability development in the very regions hosting the infrastructure.

signals.title: AI Has Already Arrived in Roanoke’s Classrooms. Here’s What Parents, Students, and Workers Should Know. - The Roanoke Rambler
signals.signal_reading: AI's arrival in Roanoke classrooms through platform tools suggests shallow but distributed adoption—students and teachers using AI without necessarily developing deep technical understanding, testing whether superficial exposure builds future capability or dependency.

signals.title: AI helped a Virginia mom launch Here Now Health and expand Medicaid mental health services - Межа. Новини України.
signals.signal_reading: A Virginia mother using AI to launch and scale Medicaid mental health services demonstrates grassroots, domain-specific AI adoption that combines deep understanding of local needs with practical tool deployment—a potential model for distributed, purpose-driven capability building outside traditional tech sectors.
